Messages.Author: Makish
Messages.Body:
My vampire enter in combat with another and send him to torpor.
After, still ready, I play Amaranth. In my influence phase,
I influence the same vampire, contesting him. May Blood Hunt
still be called on him?

Thanks in advance for any reply!

Makish

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Makish <mak...@my-dejanews.com> wrote:
> My vampire enter in combat with another and send him to torpor.
> After, still ready, I play Amaranth. In my influence phase,
> I influence the same vampire, contesting him. May Blood Hunt
> still be called on him?

A Blood Hunt can only be called at the time the diablerie is
committed. If it is not called immediately, it cannot be called
at all.

--

Messages.Author: Patrick Harris
Messages.Body:
> My vampire enter in combat with another and send him to torpor. After,
> still ready, I play Amaranth. In my influence phase, I influence the same
> vampire, contesting him. May Blood Hunt
> still be called on him?

Vampire A (yours) sends Vampire B to torpor. You play Amaranth to burn Vamp
B instead of sending him to torpor. The Blood Hunt on Vamp A must be called
immediately, if it is to be called. There is no time for you to influence
any minions.

p.
